# EUTOOM — Quanzhou Guolan Trading Co., Ltd.

> Bathroom & kitchen hardware manufacturer, China. Founded 2006. Two factories: Wenzhou (Zhejiang, 2006) and Quanzhou (Fujian, 2019).

## What we make
- Kitchen faucets (pull-out, gooseneck, high-arc commercial, wall-mounted) — model series 83xx/84xx
- Basin mixers (hot & cold, pull-out, swivel, waterfall-design) — model series 80xx/81xx/86xx
- Shower systems (rain sets, thermostatic, LED digital, concealed, simple sets) — model series 70xx/71xx
- Smart sensor faucets (infrared automatic) — model series 30xx
- Angle valves, bidet sprays, flush valves, scuppers, hose pipes, floor drains — model series 60xx/63xx/65xx/66xx
- Bathroom accessory 6-piece sets — series 100/200/300/501/700/801/900
- Toilets & vanities — range being finalized for launch

## Finishes
Polished chrome (A), matte black (B), gold/brass (C), gunmetal/brushed grey (E), two-tone black-gold (BC) and chrome-gold (CH).
